messages:
jasmin_cs: Hey team — customer ACME-231 flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard for Feb shows 1,120,345 tokens but invoice 2026-02-28-789 billed 1,184,560 tokens (~+64k). Suspect cutoff/window issue around midnight UTC. Any known metering re-ingestion or clock/drift events in the 00:00–00:10 UTC window? cc @omar_billing

omar_billing: thx Jasmin. Can you drop account id (got it) and a couple example call_ids or timestamps we can trace? Also attach the invoice pdf if available.

jasmin_cs: acct ACME-231, invoice 2026-02-28-789 attached to ticket. Sample call_ids: c-8f2a, c-9d3b. Dashboard hourly_aggregates shows rows up to 2026-02-28 23:59:00 UTC. Invoice line items include tokens processed at 2026-03-01 00:05:12 UTC.

samir_eng: pinging metering team. Quick glance at metering logs: the ttl-batcher on metering-agg-3 restarted at 00:03 UTC (OOM) and re-ingestion occurred. Some batches arrived after midnight and were stamped with arrival_time used by aggregator. Possible that arrival_time -> Mar 01 window.

liam_ops: confirm — metering-agg-3 had NTP jitter ~+8s vs control for a few minutes; that's not huge but combined with using batch arrival_time for day bucketing it could shift records across boundary. Will check host logs.

samir_eng: short technical note: aggregation logic historically prefers processed/arrival_time for dedupe reasons in reingestions. event_time is present but we only use it for streamy counts unless backfill flag used. If a batch is reprocessed after midnight we can mis-attribute to next day.

jasmin_cs: customer is asking for a clear explanation and whether we will credit. They want ETA to resolution.

samir_eng: repro steps I used in staging:
1) SELECT * FROM raw_events WHERE call_id = 'c-8f2a'; -- shows event_time = '2026-02-28 23:58:42+00'
2) examine aggregated rows: SELECT day, SUM(tokens) FROM hourly_aggregates WHERE account_id='ACME-231' AND call_id='c-8f2a' GROUP BY day;
3) run backfill: python jobs/aggregate.py --account ACME-231 --start 2026-02-28 --end 2026-03-01 --use-event-time
Expected: token moves into 2026-02-28 bucket (instead of Mar 1). I'll run in staging first and capture before/after counts.

omar_billing: please include a before/after diff and CC finance@redwood. For accounting we need an audit trail prior to any invoice adjustment.

metering-bot: job aggregate_backfill_2212345678 queued by samir_eng

liam_ops: I'm applying an NTP fix and restarting metering-agg-3 now (ETA ~10m). Will run a quick health check after.

samir_eng: ran the backfill in staging — results snapshot:
- 2026-02-28 bucket: +63,912 tokens
- 2026-03-01 bucket: -63,912 tokens
This migrates the ~63.9k tokens from Mar1 into Feb28 on the dashboard.

omar_billing: note — invoice service charges based on billing_events.processed_at which is populated from metering pipeline processed_time. If processed_time was after midnight those tokens were included in the Mar1 invoice. So root cause theory holds: re-ingestion + arrival_time usage -> processed_at after cutoff -> billed in Mar1.

jasmin_cs: customer asks for ETA and a one-line explanation we can send them.

omar_billing: proposed external wording: "We discovered a metering re-ingestion that retried after midnight UTC; during the retry the pipeline recorded those events as being processed after the cutoff, which put them onto the next invoice. We're backfilling the aggregates to use original event timestamps and will submit an invoice adjustment if the backfill changes billed totals. ETA 24–48h for confirmation and next steps." Please hold off on any credit until finance reviews.

maria_finance: finance here — once CS provides the pre/post diffs and a short memo, we'll review for an adjustment. Per policy, anything >$100 requires manager approval; smaller items we can auto-credit in the next cycle.

jasmin_cs: I'll prepare the memo and the before/after screenshots and attach the ticket.

samir_eng: starting prod backfill now (job id backfill-2212345678-prod). Will post the exact token deltas when complete.

metering-bot: backfill-2212345678-prod completed: Feb28 +63,912 tokens, Mar01 -63,912 tokens. New dashboard total for ACME-231 recalculated.

samir_eng: verified: dashboard now shows 1,184,560 tokens which matches the invoice total. Root cause confirmed: re-ingestion arrival_time -> processed_at after midnight. Fixes: (1) ops patched NTP on metering cluster; (2) ENG PR to prefer event_time for day bucketing (github.com/redwood/meters/pull/452); (3) we're running a scan across accounts with activity in 00:00–00:10 UTC window to find other mismatches.

omar_billing: action items:
- jasmin_cs: collect before/after evidence and submit memo to finance (today)
- maria_finance: review memo & approve / deny adjustment
- samir_eng: monitor for additional affected accounts; deploy aggregator patch to canary tonight
- liam_ops: run NTP audit across metering hosts and report status
ETA: 24–48h to complete the loop.

maria_finance: ack. We'll triage when we receive the evidence and will aim to process any approved credit on next billing run or issue proforma credit sooner if requested by customer.

jasmin_cs: sending to customer now with the proposed wording and ETA. Thanks all :pray:

liam_ops: added a follow-up ticket to infra runbook to check NTP and reprocess windows after machine restarts.

samir_eng: I'll post the scan results in this thread when ready. Reacted :eyes: to the backfill success.
__note: One Slack thread. Messages are a single continuous string with sender prefixes per agents.md rules.
